local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game:GetService("CoreGui"))

-- Loading Screen
local loadFrame = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
loadFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
loadFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
loadFrame.ZIndex = 10

local loadText = Instance.new("TextLabel", loadFrame)
loadText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
loadText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
loadText.Text = "meow"
loadText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
loadText.TextSize = 50
loadText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

task.wait(2)
loadFrame:Destroy()

-- Decorated Boombox
local frame = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 130)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.4, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", frame)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 2

local input = Instance.new("TextBox", frame)
input.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0)
input.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.15, 0)
input.PlaceholderText = "ENTER ID"
input.Text = ""
input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
input.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Instance.new("UICorner", input)

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.55, 0)
btn.Text = "PLAY"
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 255)
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Instance.new("UICorner", btn)

local s = Instance.new("Sound", game:GetService("SoundService"))

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    s:Stop()
    s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://"..input.Text:gsub("%D", "")
    s:Play()
end)

scripts.title: FE CUBE MONSTER
scripts.script:
-- [[ FE CUBE MONSTER ULTIMATE V9 ]]
-- Специально для Глеба
-- Фикс: Голова по центру (0), смотрит ПРЯМО, только вверх-вниз

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- 1. НЕВИДИМОСТЬ
for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then part.Transparency = 1 end
end

local function createCube(size, offset, name)
    local cube = Instance.new("Part", char)
    cube.Name = name; cube.Size = size; cube.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    cube.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; cube.CanCollide = false
    local weld = Instance.new("Weld", cube)
    weld.Part0 = char.HumanoidRootPart; weld.Part1 = cube; weld.C0 = offset
    return cube
end

-- 2. ТЕЛО (Голова теперь ровно на 0 по X и смотрит ПРЯМО)
local head = createCube(Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5), CFrame.new(0, 4, 0), "CubeHead")
local lHand = createCube(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), CFrame.new(-3, 1, 0), "LeftHand")
local rHand = createCube(Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), CFrame.new(3, 1, 0), "RightHand")

-- 3. ОРУЖИЕ (Меч -180, Нож -90)
local function addWeapon(id, parentPart, offset)
    local obj = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id)[1]
    obj.Parent = char
    for _, v in pairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Script") or v:IsA("LocalScript") then v:Destroy() end
    end
    local handle = obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if handle then
        handle.CanCollide = false
        local w = Instance.new("Weld", handle)
        w.Part0 = parentPart; w.Part1 = handle; w.C0 = offset
    end
end

addWeapon(47433, rHand, CFrame.new(0, 0, -2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-180), 0, 0))
addWeapon(3576051114, lHand, CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))

-- 4. ЗВУКИ
local sKnife = Instance.new("Sound", char.HumanoidRootPart)
sKnife.SoundId = "rbxassetid://136518851744814"
local sSword = Instance.new("Sound", char.HumanoidRootPart)
sSword.SoundId = "rbxassetid://111147793954530"

-- 5. АТАКА
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    sKnife:Play(); sSword:Play()
    lHand.Weld.C0 = lHand.Weld.C0 * CFrame.new(0,0,-2.5)
    rHand.Weld.C0 = rHand.Weld.C0 * CFrame.new(0,0,-2.5)
    task.wait(0.08)
    lHand.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(-3, 1, 0)
    rHand.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(3, 1, 0)
end)

-- 6. НОВАЯ ПЛАВНАЯ АНИМАЦИЯ (БЕЗ ВРАЩЕНИЯ ГОЛОВЫ)
spawn(function()
    while task.wait() do
        local t = tick()
        -- Голова плавно ходит вверх-вниз по оси Y (4 + синус)
        head.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 4 + math.sin(t*1.5)*0.4, 0) 
        
        -- Руки плавно качаются
        lHand.Weld.C0 = lHand.Weld.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(-3, 1 + math.cos(t*3)*0.4, 0.5 * math.sin(t)), 0.1)
        rHand.Weld.C0 = rHand.Weld.C0:Lerp(CFrame.new(3, 1 + math.sin(t*3)*0.4, 0.5 * math.cos(t)), 0.1)
    end
end)

print("Глеб, V9 готова! Голова ровная и плавает вверх-вниз. ⚔️🦾🧱")

scripts.title: CHAINIX Universal
scripts.features:
Here's a full breakdown of every feature in CHAINIX Universal:

⚔️ Combat

Rage Mode — Teleports to enemies and kills them one by one, auto-respawns if you die
Auto Loadout — Automatically picks your weapons when a round starts; customizable primary, secondary, melee, and utility slots with arrow selectors
Aimbot — Hold RMB to lock onto enemies; includes FOV circle, wall check, and mouse movement alignment
FOV Circle — Toggle the aimbot FOV visualizer
FOV Radius slider — Adjust aimbot FOV size (50–500)
Smoothness slider — Control how snappy the aimbot locks on
Triggerbot — Auto-fires when your crosshair is over an enemy; configurable delay
Trigger Delay slider — Set delay in milliseconds (0–200ms)
Aim Assist — Subtle camera nudge toward nearby enemies (least detectable)
Assist Strength slider — Control how strong the nudge is
Instant Reload — Patches reload timers to near-zero


👁️ ESP

Enable ESP — Master toggle for all ESP features
Show Names — Display player usernames above their character
Show Health — Show HP bar and numbers
Show Distance — Show how far away each player is in meters
Highlight / Wallhack — Highlights players through walls; color-coded by team


🏃 Movement

Speed Boost — Increases walk speed with a slider (16–100)
Infinite Jump — Allows jumping mid-air repeatedly (keybind: J)
Jump Power slider — Adjust jump height (50–200)
Flight System — Full fly mode with WASD + Space/Shift controls (keybind: C)
Flight Speed slider — Adjust flight speed (20–200)
Noclip — Walk through walls (keybind: N)


👥 Players

Player list — Shows all players with live distance and health
Teleport to Player — One-click teleport to any player
Refresh button — Manually refresh the player list
Auto-refresh — Updates when players join or leave


🌐 Server

Rejoin Server — Reconnects to the same server
Server Hop — Finds and joins a different server
Join Low Player Server — Finds the server with fewest players
Live Ping display — Shows your current ping with color-coded indicator
Hop for Better Ping — Auto-hops if your ping is above 80ms


🎛️ Misc

Performance Mode — Disables shadows and lowers quality for FPS boost
Remove Textures — Strips all part textures for extra FPS
No Fog — Removes world fog
FPS Unlocker — Sets FPS cap to 240
Fullbright — Maximizes lighting brightness
Zoom Extender — Extends camera zoom distance to 1000 studs
No Camera Shake — Locks camera to prevent shake effects
FOV Changer — Custom FOV with slider (70–120), continuously enforced
Show FPS — On-screen FPS counter with color coding
Show Ping — On-screen ping counter with color coding
Auto Respawn — Auto-respawns your character on death
8 Themes — White (Default), Dark Mode, Ocean Blue, Neon Pink, Matrix Green, Blood Red, Purple, Gold


⚙️ Settings

Enable/Disable Notifications
Enable/Disable Sounds
Auto Save Config — Saves settings to a file between sessions
Save Config Now / Reload Config / Reset to Defaults
Custom Crosshair — Minimal crosshair overlay
Toggle UI keybind — Rebindable (default: Insert)
Unload Script keybind — Rebindable (default: Delete)
Hide UI button
Feature keybinds — Rebind Flight, Infinite Jump, ESP, and Noclip individually
Unload CHAINIX — Full cleanup with character respawn


ℹ️ Info

Version info and credits
Discord invite link (copies to clipboard)
Changelog summary
